title: Clarity beats complexity
excerpt: Clear writing and clear code are the same skill: choosing what to omit.
contentHtml:
Complexity is often a symptom of fear: fear of missing an edge case, fear of not sounding smart, fear of being judged. The antidote is clarity. Write the smallest thing that communicates the point. Extract it when it repeats. Delete the rest.

Clarity scales. Teams move faster when decisions are legible.
